div.div: الأُذُنُ مَجَّاجَةٌ وَلِلنَّفْسِ حَمْضَةٌ (assumed tropical:) The ear is wont to reject instruction, through forgetfulness, while the mind has eager desire to listen thereto, is said in a trad. (TA.) And in another trad., وَلِلنَّفْسِ حَمْضَةٌ ↓ لِلْأُذُنِ مَجَّةٌ [meaning the same]. (TA., art. حمض.) [See also حَمْضَةٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
